content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Kanpur JRF Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT Kanpur JRF recruitment is 31st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the JRF post at IIT Kanpur?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIT Kanpur.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in any branch of Life Sciences. CSIR-NET/GATE/DBT-JRF qualification is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the JRF position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for this recruitment must be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the IIT Kanpur JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF role at IIT Kanpur will involve an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this IIT Kanpur JRF recruitment is P.Rect./R&D/2026/159.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT Kanpur located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur is located in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 208016.
